evidence: Geometry and routing read from products: the design surface's seas on the redrawn floor at 16 pixels a degree and the design routing's mean flows on the estimated design climate. A mouth is a cell; a river's course and the floor below its mouth follow single cells of about 1.9 km, so slopes and hollows finer than that are not seen. Nothing is measured.
reading_rule: Levels in m above the dry Moon's geoid, depths in m below each sea's own level, areas km2, volumes km3, flows m3/s. seas[name].below lists the area and volume of the water deeper than each depth. rivers[name].kept are the largest rivers that carry 95% of the sea's river water (at most 20), each with its course up to the water that sets its temperature (course.km, course.fall_m from that water's level to the mouth, the small lakes passed, and course.source: the first lake holding at least 1.7e5 m2 for each m3/s through it, with its level, area and mean depth, or a higher sea), the floor below its mouth down the steepest way to a first lowest point (floor.depth_reached[z]: the distance at which the floor first lies z m deep and the mean slope to there), the hollows its water of ten years would fill and pass (floor.hollows_passed) and the hollow that holds it longer (floor.lowest_depth_m and floor.pool: the joined water below each height above its lowest point, within 12 degrees). small_m3s is the rest of the sea's river water.
